normal_projects.app_description_small: A smart recipe app that helps users explore, save, and share delicious recipes from the internet.
normal_projects.app_description_large: Savory Safari is a powerful recipe discovery app designed to help food lovers explore, save, and share a vast collection of recipes from the internet. Users can search for recipes based on ingredients, cuisine, or dietary preferences and access step-by-step instructions with images and videos. The app features a personalized recommendation system, allowing users to discover new recipes based on their past searches and preferences. It also supports saving favorite recipes, creating shopping lists, and even generating meal plans. With a sleek UI and seamless navigation, Savory Safari is the ultimate companion for cooking enthusiasts, making it easier than ever to try out new dishes at home.

normal_projects.app_description_small: All in one Indian Spices store which can be delivered to your doorstep.
normal_projects.app_description_large:
Pepper Train is an online spice store with an initiative to share and sustain the passion for spices. Rooted in the land of spices, we go to a great extent to connect you to the land of exotic spice range within a single click. Pepper Train is a one-stop destination for all online spice shoppers. 
Organic cultivation is a healthier choice that we need to adapt for us and the planet. We rely entirely on natural resources, biodiversity, and cycles adapted to the local climatic conditions rather than using poisonous chemicals fertilizers, and pesticides. Thereby we aim to regenerate the health of our planet, ecosystem, and people. Conscious food choices, with trusted farmers who diligently work towards the well-being of the planet, you can be assured about the quality of our products and our sincere efforts to make a positive change. 
Our natural and organic range of spices, herbs, and oils will enhance and completely renovate your cooking with Its freshness and goodness. You will find everything you are looking for as a tastemaker. Pepper Train makes sure that these spices are exclusively handpicked directly from the farmers to ensure the best quality.

normal_projects.app_description_small: Discover a vast collection of high-quality wallpapers, making it easy to personalize and enhance your device screen effortlessly.
normal_projects.app_description_large: PixaVista is a feature-rich wallpaper app that helps users discover and set stunning high-quality images for their home and lock screens. With an intuitive search and predefined categories, finding the perfect wallpaper is quick and seamless. Users can easily customize wallpapers with cropping and scaling options for a perfect fit. The app supports offline access, enabling users to save and share wallpapers effortlessly. Whether for daily personalization or special occasions, PixaVista makes device customization simple and enjoyable.
